description: This file defines a React functional component 'AIChat' that implements a mock AI chat popup widget, including state management for visibility, messages, user input, and simple scripted responses. It includes UI elements for opening, closing, and interacting with the chat, utilizing react-icons for icons and JSX for rendering.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles sending the user message, generating a canned response based on simple regex matching, updating the messages state, and clearing the input field.
